svg.text: 3D CAD Model 9: Modular Hard Deck Seating (Flush L-Tracks + 1 or 2 Low-Sit Chairs)
5-sec quick-release slide between Solo (1 chair @ CoG), Tandem (2 chairs inline), and Open Deck (0 chairs, 100% flush!)
Legs extend naturally onto upturned bow deck!
22° lumbar recline • Fits 600 mm tunnel cleanly
100% flush with deck — zero trip hazard when empty!
Aft Pilot Chair (Slides to Solo CoG!)
Slide 1 chair to X ≈ 0 mm for solo 70+ nm flights
Right-hand thumb-throttle & joystick move with chair!
Packs into 2 halves • Houses 5.38 kWh dry pack
Zero deck boxes, zero hull holes!
